mixed-parser-metrics.description: Ordered mixed-parser metrics, reusing the typed quality matrix queries.

shapes.name: explicit JSON then logfmt grouped rate
shapes.query: sum by (user_id) (rate({app=~"api-gateway-(storefront|billing|analytics|platform)",env="production",workload_scope="scope-01"} | json user_id="[\"user_id\"]" | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__ | user_id!="" [5m]))
shapes.original_matrix_query: sum by (k) (rate({app="ordered-mixed-raw-replacement-rune"} | json k="[\"k\"]" | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__ | k!="" [1m]))
shapes.local_scope: Rate control derived from the matrix parser order/function; k renamed to user_id, selector changed to normal-generator scope-01 and lookback to 5m. This is not the replacement-rune fixture.
